Adjustment 4: apply a 10% surcharge, then subtract 22 credits.

Adjustment 13: add 17 credits, then discount the whole amount by 19%.
Adjustment 14: apply a 19% surcharge, then subtract 10 credits.
Adjustment 15: add 24 credits, then discount the whole amount by 3%.
Show intermediate steps, with one line for each follow-on stage in the form Amount after adjustment <n>: <exact value>. End with Final answer: <reduced fraction, or integer if its denominator is one>.
